scope.answers: Frozen 3,680 fit answers only: native 634 followed by expanded 3,046.
scope.labels: Only fit token/window annotations are opened in prepare.
scope.calibration: No path constant and no read operation.
scope.official_test: No path constant and no read operation.

identity.group: Locked source-connected group_id; all response, claim and window units inherit it through response_index.
identity.cache_order: First the whitelist/native 634, then new_token_plans 3,046; exactly the fit token/window order.

gold.window_rule: Every stride-one contiguous raw-BPE window of width 4; answers shorter than 4 yield one shortened window. Eligible iff at least one original alphanumeric-overlap BPE. Label is OR of original token risk over the window.

projection.claim_to_token: Broadcast each claim scalar to its exact lexical BPE owners; punctuation tokens receive fill_value.
projection.claim_to_window: Maximum of claim scores owning lexical BPEs in the exact window. This is a prediction projection and is not asserted to reproduce fine token gold.
projection.token_to_window: Maximum over lexical BPE scores in the exact window.
projection.window_to_answer: Maximum over every eligible window belonging to the answer.
projection.threshold: No threshold exists in this module.

features.native: Read-only semantic_source_attribution_v1 feature triplets for exact whitelist response IDs only.
features.full_edges: Remain in verified per-answer shards; no second 1.22-GiB CSR copy is made.

stage_gate: prepare may run immediately; audit waits for both caches; no training, model selection, threshold selection, calibration, test, model load, or GPU operation
